in_hebrew.name: Orelee
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Orelee הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'oreos' meaning 'mountain' and 'lea' meaning 'laurel'. This name signifies a beautiful and strong woman, associated with the protection and grace of mountains.

in_greek.name: Orelee

This name signifies a beautiful and strong woman, associated with the protection and grace of mountains.

in_latin.name: Orelee

This name signifies a beautiful and strong woman, associated with the protection and grace of mountains.
